Peggy is a researcher from the Succubus town.

Her research focuses on the ecology of rare monsters. She is known for a bold investigative method - she descends dangerous dungeons herself to observe monsters. She is also a prolific writer and has published multiple books which became must-read among adventurers.

She wears thick glasses on purpose as she doesn't want to accidentally seduce her colleagues.

He lost the ability to speak after a certain incident in his childhood. He can still telepathically communicate with his sister, but has hard time interacting with anyone else. Unlike his sister, Favi is timid and easily scared.

Damage inflicted by enemies decreases by 25%.
On hit, continuously deal 70% of DPS damage once every 3 seconds.
terms.战斗就交给我吧。一个人已经足够了。: Leave the battle to me. I can handle this alone.

terms.首领狩猎…不管什么时候做都很开心。: Boss hunting…  is always a pleasure.
terms.首领能让我多兴奋呢…真期待。: How much can this boss entertain me… I can't wait.
terms.马上就能吃到一大堆美味的烤香鱼了！: I'll get to eat all the delicious grilled sweetfish I want now!
terms.驱灵：发射鬼火，对敌人造成远程伤害；命中目标时，恢复生命最少队员的生命。\n召唤:
Exorcism: Throws Goblin Fire to inflict ranged damage to enemies. On hit, restores the HP of the party member with the lowest HP. 
Totem Summoning: Summons a totem pole that causes an earthquake to taunt and inflict ranged damage to enemies. The HP of the totem pole can’t be restored and on hit, the enemy’s Atk and Weapon Skill regen speed decreases by 20% for 3 seconds. The totem pole is dismissed at the end of the battle or after 7 seconds.
terms.驱魔斩：使用驱魔剑术，对敌人造成近程伤害；优先攻击战士。\n花影：展开以莎娅为中:
Exorcist Slash : Uses swordsmanship that cuts ghosts to inflict melee damage to the enemies. Attacks Warriors first.
Flower Shadow : Creates a field around Saya for 4 seconds. Exorcist Slash changes to Exorcist Unsheathing and deals melee damage to up to 4 enemies inside the field. This can be used up to 5 times. Once Exorcist Unsheathing is used up, the field is closed. On Exorcist Unsheathing's hit, marks targets with a cherry blossom emblem, reducing their Def by 10% for 2 seconds.
terms.驾乘机车快速前进，并挥动双手剑攻击敌人。: Moves quickly on a motorcycle while wielding a two-handed sword.
terms.骑上摩托，再挥舞它，简直帅呆了！: It'll rock if I swing this on the bike!
terms.骑士？公主？真是异世界啊。: Knight? Princess? I am too normal for this...
terms.骑士…不，不是，偶像训练无止境！: Never stop training, I mean singing!
terms.骑士不该奢侈。但…偶尔应该没问题吧。: Knights do not need luxuries. But… Maybe this one time…
terms.骑士严禁奢侈…但，我现在是艺人！: Knights do not need luxuries.. but..I'm an idol!
terms.骰子已经掷下，买定离手。: The die's already been cast. There's no turning back now.

terms.高阶土属性进化石箱子: High Grade Earth type Evolution Stone Box
terms.高阶暗属性进化石箱子: High Grade Dark type Evolution Stone Box
terms.高阶水属性进化石箱子: High Grade Water type Evolution Stone Box
terms.高阶火属性进化石箱子: High Grade Fire type Evolution Stone Box
terms.高阶虚属性进化石箱子: High Grade Basic type Evolution Stone Box
terms.高高在上的人不懂风格有多重要。: It's important to look good. But the higher-ups don't understand that.
terms.鬼玉枪术：使用鬼玉山世家枪术，对敌人造成近程伤害；最后一次攻击命中目标时，为被命:
Jade Spearmanship: Employs spearmanship of the House of Jade Mountain to inflict melee damage to enemies. If the last attack is a hit, the enemy is marked with a Jade Mask emblem, reducing their Def by 10% for 3 seconds.
Puppetry Spell (Beast Warrior): Summons a Beast Warrior controlled by the Mask of Dominion. The Beast Warrior appears only during battle and deals melee damage.
terms.魂灵玉：发射蕴含灵魂的宝珠，对敌人造成远程伤害。\n灵魂爆发：进入灵魂充盈状态并:
Soul Sphere: Fires spheres imbued with soul to inflict ranged damage to enemies.
Soul Blast: Becomes full of soul for 7 seconds. In this state, her Atk increases by 20%.
terms.魅魔名门望族的独生女，比安卡来了。: I believe I'll have to say hello in a courteous manner for decency.
terms.魔力花瓣：发射魔力花瓣，对敌人造成远程伤害；攻击命中一定次数时，可使用“净化花瓣:
Magic Petal : Fires magic petals to inflict ranged damage to enemies. She can use Petals of Purification by reaching a certain number of target hits.
Petals of Purification : Restores the HP of allies around her and removes all negative Effects. Petals of Purification is strengthened up to 3 levels depending on the number of Magic Petal hits.
terms.魔弹：朝不同方向发射对敌人造成伤害的5发魔弹。\n治愈光：恢复被激光击中的我方人:
Spell Bullet: Fires five-way spell bullets.
Healing Ray: Launches a healing laser that restores allies' HP and removes negative Effects.
terms.魔法最大的乐趣是寻求它的过程。: The process of searching for magic is the most fun part.
terms.魔法师的等级大大成长了呢！: I feel my caliber as a mage really leveled up like crazy!
terms.魔界会议厅后方: Back Side of the Conference Hall
terms.魔神之力可不是闹着玩的。: A Demon God's power is no joke.
terms.魔神的背影说明了一切: The Demon God's Back Says It All
terms.魔神重击：挥拳对敌人造成近程伤害。\n接稳了！：投掷巨型熔岩石，造成远程伤害并嘲:
Demon God Punch: Swings her fists to deal melee damage to enemies.
Take this!: Throws a giant lava boulder at the enemy to inflict ranged damage and taunt nearby enemies.
terms.鱼鹰，前来报到！发现目标，准备清除！: Osprey reporting. Target will be eliminated.
terms.鲜血与汗水…一切为了皇女。: All this sweat… And blood… For the princess!
terms.麻烦你帮我看看身上的伤…可以吗？: …Could you have a look at my wounds…?
terms.麻烦的事情，我来摆平，希望我们合作愉快！: Leave the inconveniences to me. Let's do this!
terms.麻烦的事还是早点解决比较好。: I'd rather get troublesome things out of the way.
terms.黑暗之矛：使用枪术，对敌人造成远程伤害。\n暗影藤蔓：对前方敌人造成远程伤害。被:
Dark Spear: Employs spearmanship to inflict ranged damage.
Shadow Vine: Inflicts ranged damage to enemies. On hit, marks enemies with the Corps Commander’s emblem, reducing their Def by 10% for 6 seconds.
terms.黑暗利爪：利用黑暗力量对敌人造成近程伤害。\n黑暗利刺：在敌人身上投下黑暗物质造:
Darkness Claw: Uses dark powers to inflict melee damage to enemies. 
Darkness Spike: Drops dark matter on enemies to inflict melee damage. On hit, marks enemies with the Demon Queen's emblem, reducing their Def by 10% for 6 seconds.
terms.黑暗魔力：迸射魔力，对敌人造成伤害。\n超速移动：快速移动至附近位置。:
Dark Magic: Fires mana to inflict damage to enemies.
Teleport: Moves quickly to a nearby location.
terms.龙骑士夏皮拉，前来执行任务，请求协助。: I am Shapira. A knight serving princess Aisha. I ask for your cooperation.

forest_main_s7_1: 等，等下我…！年纪大了，跑不动了！
H, Hold on...! I'm too old for all this running!
forest_main_s7_2: 我想知道去遗迹到底要干什么？
Why go to the old ruins anyways?
forest_main_s7_3: 那里非常危险！我可承诺过要保护你的！
That place is very dangerous! I promised your friend to keep you safe!
forest_main_s7_4: 小姐，不要去那里。我可以给你上千个理由！
I can give you a thousand reasons not to go there. You behave, missy!
forest_main_s7_7: 父亲他一直告诉我：聪明的女王擅长抚慰人民。
Dad always told me... a good queen always persuades her people.
forest_main_s7_8: 所以，你可以试试说服我不去遗迹……
Okay, let's try this. You go ahead and try to convince me not to go...
forest_main_s7_9: …然后，我很有信心说服你不拦着我。
...and I'll convince you to let me go.
forest_main_s8_phone_subtitle: You can use this anywhere at any time.
forest_main_s8_phone_description: 虽然旧了一点，但用起来没问题。
It's a little old but works like a charm.
forest_main_s9_boss_panda_subtitle: 可爱外表下蕴含凶猛的战斗力？
forest_main_s12_boss_mech_subtitle: One for all, all for one.
dragon_knight_2: 明…明白。由我承担所有责任…
I understand… I'll take full responsibility.
dragon_knight_3: Um… don't you think hanging is a bit extreme…
dragon_knight_5: 怎，怎么回事！你干嘛追到这儿来？！
dragon_knight_7: 呜呜…坎特伯雷的穷乡僻壤竟然有这么厉害的家伙…
I can't believe there's still formidable knights like you in this dump of a kingdom…
dragon_knight_8: However, I can't go out like this!
dragon_knight_boss_subtitle: 身份不详的女骑士，看上去蛮厉害的。
Mysterious Knight. She looks very powerful.
forest_main_s8_0_0: 那几个雇佣兵肯定是往这边走的。
The mercenaries must've gone this way.
forest_main_s8_0_1: 但是你一个人去太危险了。
But it's dangerous to go alone.
forest_main_s8_0: 这是我妹妹用过的手机，虽然有点老，但是还能用。
This is kind of old, but it should do just fine.
forest_main_s8_1: 我的号码已经存进去了，如果需要帮忙，随时找我！
I'll send you useful info as you journey along.
forest_main_s8_4: Don't look at me like that…
forest_main_s8_5: 反正，现在该去找你的朋友了吧？
Anyways! It's time to find your friend!
forest_main_s8_tracker_0: 请追上逃走的雇佣兵团。
forest_main_s9_3: 原来是刚才那家伙，你是怎么逃出来的？
It's you! Ogre face! How did you escape?
forest_main_s9_4: 本大爷现在有点不爽，正好拿你出出气。
The big panda is a little pissed off at the moment…
forest_main_s9_6: 呃…要是以前我膝盖没有中那一箭…
If only I didn't take that arrow to the knee back then…
forest_main_s9_7: …怎么了，你以为盯着我就怕你了吗？
What? You think I'm afraid of you?
forest_main_s9_8: 不可以直视大人的眼睛…
forest_main_s9_10: 你要找的小孩子往坎特伯雷遗迹走了。
The kid you're after went towards the Kanterbury Ruins.
forest_main_s9_11: 这种事情真心不想干了…
I'm getting too old for this…
forest_main_s9_tracker_0: 请追上逃走的雇佣兵团。
forest_main_s95_2: I've got some stuff to take care of…
forest_main_s95_3: You can handle this on your own, right?
forest_main_s95_4: I'll be back as soon as I can.
forest_main_s10_0: 回来！你这没良心的家伙！你家人也知道你的这种行为吗？
Come back here you heartless wench!
forest_main_s10_1: 这是漂亮姐姐给丹尼的面包！丹尼被困住了，小孩子她走了。
forest_main_s10_2: 哇，就为了这几枚金币和小面包，我们错过了值300万金币的小家伙！！！
forest_main_s10_3: 喂，你！说你呢！哥哥！姐姐！冒险家先生！
Hey, over there! Excuse me, good sir!
forest_main_s10_4: 那个小孩子吗？好哇，我可以告诉你！
The girl? Sure, I can tell you.
forest_main_s10_5: 不过消息要用钱买。不必太多，只需3000枚金币…
That info comes with a price, though.
forest_main_s10_6: 旅馆老板娘把我们困在这里！还带走了小孩子！
The Kanterbury innkeeper lady trap us! Take girl! Bad lady!
forest_main_s10_8: 她们是从旁边这条路走的，丹尼有跟她招手！
They go that way. Danny waved bye bye.
forest_main_s10_9: …好的，就是这样。旅馆老板娘抢走了那个小孩子。
…welp, that's what happened. The innkeeper took the kid.
forest_main_s10_10: 是…是真的？！不信你打电话问问！！！
I swear! Call her and check for yourself!
forest_main_s10_11: 喂，你还不明白吗？分明是她想一个人独吞悬赏金！
Don't you get it? She's planning to take the bounty herself!
forest_main_s10_12: 剩下的你自己看着办，现在该放了我们吧？
How about you help us out now?
forest_main_s10_13: 我都讲完了！快点放了我！
You can't just leave us after we told you all that!
forest_main_s10_14: 这事不会就这么算了的！
This isn't over! We're gonna bring in the big guns!
forest_main_s10_talk_branch_1: 不要相信雇佣兵队长的话。
forest_main_s10_tracker_0: 请追上逃走的雇佣兵团。
forest_main_s11_1_1: 你的骑士朋友我们会尽快去找的。
We're going to meet up with your knight friend soon.
forest_main_s11_2: 你有没有见到找我的骑士？
Have you seen a knight looking for me?
forest_main_s11_3: 嘘！这附近是奥克的地盘，大声说话会被发现的。
Shh! This is orc territory! We've got to be quiet.
forest_main_s11_8: 过了这里，就要关掉手机。
I'm not a very good role model, am I?
forest_main_s12_1: 再走一点，就会看到旅馆！
Just a little farther to the inn.
forest_main_s12_4: 不是要去旅馆吗？可这条路刚好是反向。
You said we're going to the inn but we're going the opposite way.
forest_main_s12_5: 啊，你是在说坎特伯雷旅馆吧？
Ah, you mean the Kanterbury inn?
forest_main_s12_6: We're headed to a different inn!
forest_main_s12_7_2: 坎特伯雷地图，我了如指掌。
I memorized all the Kanterbury maps.
forest_main_s12_8: There's nothing but forest that way.
forest_main_s12_13: 让你见识一下什么叫伸张正义！
forest_main_s12_14: 该死的，竟然抢别人的饭碗！
You can't just steal someone else's bounty.
forest_main_s12_16: 她跑了！没有她我们就吃不到肉了！
She escape! Our steak dinner bye bye!
forest_main_s12_17: 这回要是逮到了，要马上绑起来！
No more messing around this time!
forest_main_s12_25: 原本以为你可能已经离开了…谢谢。
I thought you were a goner…
forest_main_s12_25_3: 姐姐和伊娃应该也安全脱险了。对吧？！
Cammie and Eva must be safe too… right?!
forest_main_s12_tracker_1: 请击退疯狂熊猫雇佣兵团。
forest_main_s13_2: This looks like some sort of treasure…
forest_main_s13_4: 看来我的力气不够。你来试试。
Do you want to give it a shot?
forest_main_s13_10: 我叫莉莉，500年前的坎特伯雷女王。
My name is Lili. I was the queen of Kanterbury 500 years ago.
forest_main_s13_11: 坎特伯雷…历史终究还是按照他们的预言在行进。
You being here must mean the prophecy has come true.
forest_main_s13_13: 嗯，迄今为止全部应验的绝对预言。
A prophecy that is bound to be fulfilled.
forest_main_s13_14: 还有，按照预言，不久将会…
forest_main_s13_15: 因未知的敌人这个世界将处于危难之中。
The unknown evil would come to bring about the end of the world.
forest_main_s13_16: …! The invaders… are they the ones in the prophecy?
forest_main_s13_17: 是的。为了对付那些未知的敌人，
Indeed. In order to defeat them…
forest_main_s13_18: 远古勇士们经历千难万险锻造终极武器，就是你手中的那把宝剑。
Ancient heroes forged an ultimate weapon. That sword in your hands.
forest_main_s13_20: 当然了。这位骑士，因为你还没有得到宝剑的认可。
That's because it is yet to find its true owner.
forest_main_s13_23: 世界意志力所选的拥有特殊命运的强者们。
Brave warriors chosen by fate itself.
forest_main_s13_24: 骑士，如果你能得到冠军们的认可…
Guardian, you must find the Champions and receive their blessings.
forest_main_s13_25: 宝剑就会把你当成真正的主人，恢复原本的威力。
Only then will the sword accept you as its owner and reveal its true power.
forest_main_s13_26: 或许…将可以化解预言里提到的世界毁灭。
We may then have a chance to prove the prophecy wrong.
forest_main_s13_27: It's time for you to go back.
forest_main_s13_27_2: 找到坎特伯雷森林的旧旅馆，你们的旅程将从那里开始。
Find the old inn of Kanterbury - the place where your journey began.
forest_main_s13_27_3: 在那儿能找到一条新路。
A new path will reveal itself.
forest_main_s13_29: I can only hope we are not too late…
forest_main_s13_29_3: 难道这也是你的预言之一吗...？
Is this all part of your prophecy…?
forest_main_s13_30: 这就是传说中的[冠军之剑]？
So this is the ultimate weapon?
forest_main_s13_33: 你不觉得我们很幸运么？得到了传说中的[冠军之剑]…
I guess we were really lucky to find this.
forest_main_s13_33_2: 现在只剩下寻找姐姐和伊娃…
Now we just have to find Cammie and Eva…
forest_main_s13_34: 可不是，我的运气还真不错。
You're right. We were really lucky.
forest_main_s13_36: 好了，你的任务结束了。公主，我们该走了。
Thanks for getting that for me, princess. Off you go now.
forest_main_s13_38: You've been very useful, my friend.
forest_main_s13_39: 如果是现在的话，或许可以让你活着回去。
Walk away and go die elsewhere.
forest_main_s13_tracker_0: 请追上逃走的旅馆老板娘。
forest_main_new_s1_6: …and we're going to find Cammie and Eva…
forest_main_new_s1_13: 我在这儿，你们这些丑陋的怪物们！
I'm over here, you filthy monsters!
forest_main_new_s3_2: A mighty fine day if you ask me.
forest_main_new_s3_3: Are you sure you'd like to speak with me?
forest_main_new_s3_4: 我当然愿意，但是你看上去有点忙。
I'd like to chat but you seem awfully busy.
forest_main_new_s3_9: 你们这些丑八怪别想抓到我！
You won't get me, you filthy creatures!
forest_main_new_s3_6: 同样都是人类。为什么呢？
forest_main_new_s4_obj: 用鼹鼠手套打碎小石块！
Use the Mole Glove to break a small rock!
forest_main_new_s4_1: 蠢货，就像飞身扑火的蝾螈。
forest_main_new_s4_2: 好，很好。让我们瞧瞧这个可怜的家伙。
Well, well, well. Let's see the poor soul.
forest_main_new_s4_3: 小朋友，盯上别人的猎物是不对的。
forest_main_new_s4_5: 丹尼今晚可以吃牛排了吗？
forest_main_new_s4_6: 当然，丹尼。今晚你可以吃两块牛排！
Of course, sweetie. You get two steaks tonight!
forest_main_new_s4_8: 这个小家伙的悬赏金300万金币就要归我们了！
You'll get many more once that 3,000,000 Gold bounty is ours.
forest_main_new_s4_11: 你不也想抓住这小女孩吗？
We know you're after the girl.
forest_main_new_s4_12: You might be good, but we're better.
forest_main_new_s4_13: 她是公主！你们犯了大罪了！
forest_main_new_s4_15: 想象中的公主原来是这个样子的啊！
Just what I'd expect from royalty.
forest_main_new_s4_16: 就这样随便在森林里遛弯？
Casually wandering through the forest, huh?
forest_main_new_s4_21: Time for us to be filthy rich!
forest_main_new_s4_24: 我的卡麦尔啊…这里到底发生什么事了呀？
forest_main_new_s4_25: 雇佣兵绑走了你的朋友…？
forest_main_new_s4_28: 我不能眼看着那小女孩受到伤害。
We've got to save that little girl.
forest_main_new_s4_29: 我有家小旅馆，就在前面不远。
I own a small inn up ahead.
forest_main_new_s4_30: 不如先到那里休整一下。
Come stop by for a bit.
forest_main_new_s4_30_2: 但在附近总能找到危险的岔路。
However, where there's a will, there's a way!
forest_main_new_s4_31: 我会想办法帮你找回你的朋友！
I'll help you save your friend!
forest_main_s6_script_2: Best of luck with finding your friend.
forest_main_s6_script_3: 呦，原来我们同路啊。我并不是跟着你哦…
We meet again. What a coincidence.
forest_main_s6_script_4: 今天是个好天气，我出来散散步。
forest_main_s6_script_5: What a coincidence. We're going the same way.
forest_main_new_s3_obj: Find a way to help the princess.
forest_main_s6_tracker_0: 追上逃走的疯狂熊猫雇佣兵团。
forest_main_new_s4_32: 不必客气。我为人人，人人为我。
We've got to help those in need.
maiden_join: 旅馆老板娘罗兰茵加入队伍！
Loraine the innkeeper joined your party!
dragon_knight_talk_0: If you value your life, don't follow me!
dragon_knight_objective_0: 追上神秘骑士并击倒他。
Catch up with the Mystery Knight and defeat him.
